Release firmware: TOSSIM, micaz. "Available on" lists the firmware whose `.defs` declares the symbol.


### LEDs

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit LED0(ubyte)` | Set LED0 (red): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LED1(ubyte)` | Set LED1 (green): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LED2(ubyte)` | Set LED2 (yellow): ON, OFF or TOGGLE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit LEDS(ubyte)` | Set the three LEDs at once: bit 0 is LED0, bit 1 LED1, bit 2 LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `OFF = 0` | LED off, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ON = 1` | LED on, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `TOGGLE = 2` | Invert the LED, for LED0, LED1 and LED2. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**LEDS**

<!-- check: ok grp -->
```terra
emit LEDS(5);   // LED0 and LED2 on, LED1 off
```

### Custom (loopback) events

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit REQ_CUSTOM()` | Loopback event without a value: CUSTOM arrives (with 0). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit REQ_CUSTOM_A(ubyte)` | Loopback event: CUSTOM\_A arrives with the same value. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await CUSTOM` → `ubyte` | Loopback event emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM; the value is always 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await CUSTOM_A` or `await CUSTOM_A(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | Loopback event emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM\_A; the value is the one emitted. With `(x)`: only when x is the value emitted by REQ\_CUSTOM\_A. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**REQ_CUSTOM_A**: Useful to signal between trails of the same program. `await CUSTOM_A(x)` waits only for the value x.

<!-- check: ok grp -->
```terra
par/and do
    var ubyte v = await CUSTOM_A;
    emit LEDS(v);
with
    emit REQ_CUSTOM_A(3);
end
```

### Radio

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `packet msgBS_t` | TerraGrp message to the base station: msgId and SEND\_DATA\_SIZE bytes of data. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit SEND_BS(msgBS_t)` | Send a msgBS\_t to the base station, through the routing tree; SENDBS\_DONE arrives in the same reaction. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await SENDBS_DONE` or `await SENDBS_DONE(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | SEND\_BS was queued (or refused); the value is the status. It does not confirm delivery. With `(x)`: only when x is the msgId of the message. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ushort getParent()` | The parent of this node in the routing tree to the base station. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte setRFPower(ubyte level)` | Radio power of the program's messages, from 0 to 7; returns SUCCESS. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `BROADCAST = 0xFFFF` | Destination address of a message to every node in range (0xFFFF). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SEND_DATA_SIZE = 16` | Size in bytes of the data field of msgBS\_t and msgGR\_t (16). | TOSSIM, micaz |

**msgBS_t**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `msgId` | `ubyte` | message id, chosen by the program; SENDBS\_DONE(x) filters by it |
| `data` | `payload[SEND_DATA_SIZE]` | SEND\_DATA\_SIZE (16) bytes of payload, replaced by the fields of a pktype |

**setRFPower**: The default is the one of the firmware build (4). The level is valid for the messages of this program and only until a new program is loaded. Values above 7 are ignored. The simulator (TOSSIM) ignores the power.

### Digital ports and interrupts

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit CFG_INT_A(ubyte)` | Configure interrupt A: RISING, FALLING or DISABLE. Each interrupt arrives in INT\_A. | micaz |
| `emit CFG_INT_B(ubyte)` | Configure interrupt B: RISING, FALLING or DISABLE. Each interrupt arrives in INT\_B. | micaz |
| `emit CFG_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Configure digital port A as input (pIN) or output (pOUT). | micaz |
| `emit CFG_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Configure digital port B as input (pIN) or output (pOUT). | micaz |
| `emit REQ_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Read digital port A; the value arrives in PORT\_A. | micaz |
| `emit REQ_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Read digital port B; the value arrives in PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `emit SET_PORT_A(ubyte)` | Set the level of digital port A (bit 0 of the argument). Configure it as pOUT first. | micaz |
| `emit SET_PORT_B(ubyte)` | Set the level of digital port B (bit 0 of the argument). Configure it as pOUT first. | micaz |
| `await INT_A` → `ushort` | Interrupt A happened (configured with CFG\_INT\_A). | micaz |
| `await INT_B` → `ushort` | Interrupt B happened (configured with CFG\_INT\_B). | micaz |
| `await PORT_A` → `ushort` | Level of digital port A, after REQ\_PORT\_A. | micaz |
| `await PORT_B` → `ushort` | Level of digital port B, after REQ\_PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `DISABLE = 2` | Interrupt disabled, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | micaz |
| `FALLING = 0` | Interrupt on the falling edge, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | micaz |
| `pIN = 0` | Port configured as input, for CFG\_PORT\_A and CFG\_PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `pOUT = 1` | Port configured as output, for CFG\_PORT\_A and CFG\_PORT\_B. | micaz |
| `RISING = 1` | Interrupt on the rising edge, for CFG\_INT\_A and CFG\_INT\_B. | micaz |

### Microphone and buzzer (MTS300 sensor board)

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `emit BEEP(ushort)` | Sound the buzzer for the given time in ms. Needs the MTS300 sensor board. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `emit REQ_MIC()` | Start sampling the microphone into the buffer given to setupMic; MIC arrives at the end. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `await MIC` → `ushort` | Microphone sampling finished: the buffer given to setupMic is full. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `ubyte setupMic(ushort* buffer, ushort count, ulong period_us, ubyte gain)` | Set the microphone sampling for REQ\_MIC: buffer, number of samples, period in us and gain. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |

**REQ_MIC**: Without a previous setupMic, the VM signals ERROR with E_NOSETUP. Needs the MTS300 sensor board.

### Groups and leader election

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `regtype group_t` | Group definition. Fill it with groupInit before using the group. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `packet msgGR_t` | TerraGrp group message: group, node, msgId and SEND\_DATA\_SIZE bytes of data. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit SEND_GR(msgGR_t)` | Send a msgGR\_t to the members of the group msg.grId; SENDGR\_DONE arrives in the same reaction. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await LEADER_LOST` or `await LEADER_LOST(ubyte x)` → `ushort` | A group lost its leader; the value is 0. With `(x)`: only when x is the group id. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await LEADER_NEW` or `await LEADER_NEW(ubyte x)` → `ushort` | A group elected a new leader; the value is its node id. With `(x)`: only when x is the group id. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await REC_GR` or `await REC_GR(ubyte x)` → `msgGR_t` | A msgGR\_t arrived from a member of a group of this node; msg.node is the sender. With `(x)`: only when x is the group id. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await SENDGR_DONE` or `await SENDGR_DONE(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | SEND\_GR was queued (or refused); the value is the status: SUCCESS, or non-zero (EINVAL, 6) for a group not declared. With `(x)`: only when x is the group id. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte groupInit(group_t group, ubyte id, ubyte param, ubyte nhops, ubyte status, ubyte elFlag, ushort leader)` (nohold) | Declare a group: id (0 to 31), param, nhops (at least 1), membership, election flag and initial leader. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `eACTIVE = 1` | Election flag: the node votes and can be elected leader. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `eOFF = 3` | Election flag: the node does not take part in the election. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ePASSIVE = 2` | Election flag: the node votes but is never elected leader. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**group_t**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `grId` | `ubyte` | group id (0 to 31) |
| `param` | `ubyte` | group parameter: two nodes are in the same group only if they use the same grId and param |
| `nhops` | `ubyte` | maximum distance, in hops, of the group messages |
| `status` | `ubyte` | TRUE if this node is a member of the group |
| `elFlag` | `ubyte` | election flag (eACTIVE, ePASSIVE or eOFF) |
| `elState` | `ubyte` | election state, kept by the VM |
| `leader` | `ushort` | current leader (0: none) |
| `nextGrp` | `ushort` | used by the VM |

**msgGR_t**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `grId` | `ubyte` | group id |
| `node` | `ushort` | on SEND\_GR, the destination (BROADCAST for every member); on REC\_GR, the sender |
| `msgId` | `ubyte` | message id, chosen by the program |
| `data` | `payload[SEND_DATA_SIZE]` | SEND\_DATA\_SIZE (16) bytes of payload, replaced by the fields of a pktype |

**SEND_GR**: The message goes as far as the nhops of the group. A group not declared with groupInit is not sent: SENDGR_DONE comes with a status other than SUCCESS (EINVAL, 6).

**groupInit**: Returns SUCCESS, or a non-zero value (EINVAL, 6) for an id above 31. Nodes are in the same group when they use the same id and param; status says whether this node is a member.

<!-- check: ok grp -->
```terra
var group_t g;
var ubyte stat = groupInit(g, 1, 0, 2, TRUE, eACTIVE, 0);
```

### Aggregation

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `regtype aggDone_t` | Result of an aggregation, returned by AGGREG\_DONE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `regtype aggreg_t` | Aggregation definition. Set agId, then fill the rest with aggregInit. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `emit AGGREG(aggreg_t)` | Run the aggregation of an aggreg\_t over its group; the result arrives in AGGREG\_DONE. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await AGGREG_DONE` or `await AGGREG_DONE(ubyte x)` → `aggDone_t` | An aggregation finished; the value is an aggDone\_t. With `(x)`: only when x is the agId of the aggregation. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ubyte aggregInit(aggreg_t agg, group_t group, ubyte sensorId, ubyte agOper, ubyte agComp, ulong refVal)` (nohold) | Declare an aggregation over a group: sensor, function, comparison and reference value. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `fAVG = 0` | Aggregation function: average of the readings. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `fMAX = 2` | Aggregation function: largest reading. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `fMIN = 3` | Aggregation function: smallest reading (0 when no node answers). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `fRESERV = 5` | Aggregation function: resource reservation. Only the answers are counted; the readings are not used. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `fSUM = 1` | Aggregation function: sum of the readings. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opEQ = 5` | Aggregation comparison: value == refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opGT = 3` | Aggregation comparison: value &gt; refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opGTE = 4` | Aggregation comparison: value &gt;= refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opLT = 1` | Aggregation comparison: value &lt; refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opLTE = 2` | Aggregation comparison: value &lt;= refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `opNEQ = 6` | Aggregation comparison: value != refVal. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_INT_A = 7` | Aggregation sensor: interrupt A. It has no reading: the value is always 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_INT_B = 8` | Aggregation sensor: interrupt B. It has no reading: the value is always 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_LEDS = 3` | Aggregation sensor: the state of the three LEDs. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_PHOTO = 2` | Aggregation sensor: light (the PHOTO reading). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_PORT_A = 5` | Aggregation sensor: digital port A. Where the firmware has no ports, the reading is 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_PORT_B = 6` | Aggregation sensor: digital port B. Where the firmware has no ports, the reading is 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_TEMP = 1` | Aggregation sensor: temperature (the TEMP reading). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SID_VOLT = 4` | Aggregation sensor: battery voltage (the VOLTS reading). | TOSSIM, micaz |

**aggDone_t**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `agId` | `ubyte` | aggregation id |
| `count` | `ushort` | number of readings aggregated (0 if the aggregation could not run) |
| `countTrue` | `ushort` | readings for which the comparison with refVal is true |
| `countFalse` | `ushort` | readings for which the comparison with refVal is false |
| `value` | `ulong` | result of the aggregation function |

**aggreg_t**

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `agId` | `ubyte` | aggregation id (0 to 7), set by the program before aggregInit; AGGREG\_DONE(x) filters by it |
| `seq` | `ushort` | sequence number, kept by the VM |
| `grId` | `ubyte` | group, copied from the group\_t by aggregInit |
| `sensorId` | `ubyte` | sensor (SID\_\*) |
| `agOper` | `ubyte` | aggregation function (fAVG, fSUM, fMAX, fMIN or fRESERV) |
| `agComp` | `ubyte` | comparison with refVal (opLT ... opNEQ) for countTrue and countFalse |
| `refVal` | `ulong` | reference value of the comparison |
| `nextAgg` | `ushort` | used by the VM |

**AGGREG**: Without aggregInit, or with the aggregation queue full, AGGREG_DONE arrives at once with count 0. A requester outside the group receives only the members' readings and does not count its own.

<!-- check: ok grp -->
```terra
var group_t g;
var aggreg_t a;
groupInit(g, 1, 0, 2, TRUE, eOFF, 0);
a.agId = 1;
aggregInit(a, g, SID_TEMP, fAVG, opGT, 500);
emit AGGREG(a);
var aggDone_t r = await AGGREG_DONE(1);
```

**aggregInit**: Set agg.agId (0 to 7) before. Returns SUCCESS, or a non-zero value (EINVAL, 6) for an agId above 7 or a group not declared with groupInit.

### Runtime errors

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `await ERROR` or `await ERROR(ubyte x)` → `ubyte` | A VM error happened; the value is the code (E\_DIVZERO, E\_IDXOVF, E\_TIMEOVF, ...). With `(x)`: only when x is the error code. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_DIVZERO = 10` | ERROR code: division or remainder by zero. The result is 0 and the program goes on. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_IDXOVF = 11` | ERROR code: array index out of bounds. The write is discarded; a read returns element 0. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_NOSETUP = 21` | ERROR code: REQ\_MIC emitted before setupMic. | no release firmware (firmware built for the MTS300 sensor board (`SENSOR=MTS300CA` or `MTS300CB`)) |
| `E_STKOVF = 20` | ERROR code: stack overflow. Fatal: the program stops. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `E_TIMEOVF = 12` | ERROR code: await time above the maximum (about 24.8 days); the wait is clamped to it. | TOSSIM, micaz |

**E_TIMEOVF**: A constant time above the maximum is a compile error (E6007). A variable or expression that goes above it waits the maximum and signals this error.

### General

| Symbol | Description | Available on |
|---|---|---|
| `ubyte getMem(ushort addr)` (pure) | One byte of the VM memory, at the given address. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ushort getNodeId()` (pure) | The id of this node. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ulong getTime()` (pure) | The VM clock, in the unit of await (1/1024 s). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `ushort random()` (pure) | A 16-bit random number. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `await_until(ret, evt, cond)` | Wait for an event until a condition holds, keeping the last value in a variable. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `FALSE = 0` | Boolean false (0). | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `SUCCESS = 0` | Status value: the operation succeeded (0). Any other status is a TinyOS error code. | TOSSIM, micaz |
| `TRUE = 1` | Boolean true (1). | TOSSIM, micaz |

**getTime**: The unit is 1/1024 s, not decimal milliseconds: the difference of two getTime() values divided by 1000 comes out 2.4% larger than the seconds elapsed.

**await_until**

<!-- check: ok grp -->
```terra
var ubyte e;
await_until(e, ERROR, e == E_DIVZERO);   // the first division by zero
emit LED0(ON);
```

### Nondeterminism

Two trails that use these symbols in the same reaction give a nondeterminism warning (W2xxx): the order of the effects is not defined.

| Symbol | Conflicts with |
|---|---|
| `CFG_INT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_INT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `CFG_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `LED0` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LED1` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LED2` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `LEDS` | `LEDS`, `LED0`, `LED1`, `LED2` |
| `REQ_CUSTOM_A` | `REQ_CUSTOM_A` |
| `REQ_PHOTO` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `REQ_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `REQ_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `REQ_TEMP` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `REQ_VOLTS` | `REQ_TEMP`, `REQ_PHOTO`, `REQ_VOLTS` |
| `SEND_BS` | `SEND_BS` |
| `SEND_GR` | `SEND_GR` |
| `SET_PORT_A` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
| `SET_PORT_B` | `SET_PORT_A`, `SET_PORT_B`, `CFG_PORT_A`, `CFG_PORT_B`, `REQ_PORT_A`, `REQ_PORT_B`, `CFG_INT_A`, `CFG_INT_B` |
